say:1:1622414001:1.text: Oh wow... this is amazing. It smells just like a Mauler bonfire feast!
say:1:1622414001:1.source_cn: 唔……这烤肉的味道太棒了，就像蛮血部落的篝火宴一样诱人！

say:2:1622414002:1.text: Hepler looks blissed-out. This is definitely hitting the mark.
say:2:1622414002:1.source_cn: 赫普脸上带着心满意足的神态，看来这份烤肉确实合他心意。

say:4:1622414003:1.source_cn: 这可是我爸爸的拿手好菜！

choice_prompt:5:1622414003.source_cn: 这可是我爸爸的拿手好菜！

say:6:1622414004:1.text: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.
say:6:1622414004:1.source_cn: 怎么会出意外，我这不是好好的？不过……有人惦记的感觉倒...
say:6:1622414004:1.male: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.
say:6:1622414004:1.female: I'm right here, in one piece! Though... it's not bad having someone worried about you. That's Solise.

say:7:1622414006:1.text: What you said back in the forest, Professor Hepler—I'm still stuck on it.
say:7:1622414006:1.source_cn: 说起来，赫普老师，您先前在森林里说的那些话，我还是有些...

say:8:1622414007:1.text: Those birds are badly hurt. Without care, they can die from infection. And what if a predator finds them?
say:8:1622414007:1.source_cn: 那些候鸟伤得那么重，如果我不继续照顾它们，万一伤口感染...

say:9:1622414008:1.text: I think... it will be so cruel if we just stand there and do nothing.
say:9:1622414008:1.source_cn: 您说要停止救助，可这样……是不是太冷酷了一些？

say:10:1622414009:1.text: I know. But I still advise against it.
say:10:1622414009:1.source_cn: 是的，我不建议你再继续帮助它们。

say:12:1622414011:1.text: The best thing you can do for them is to stop here.
say:12:1622414011:1.source_cn: 如果你真的想帮助它们，恰恰需要在这个节点停手。

say:14:1622414013:1.text: Hepler takes another huge bite, then looks Cassadee in the eye.
say:14:1622414013:1.source_cn: 赫普又吞咽下一大口烤肉，认真地看着科丝蒂。

say:15:1622414014:1.text: We'll go back and check on the flock together after dinner. Some things don't land when you hear them. You need to see them.
say:15:1622414014:1.source_cn: 等吃完晚饭，我们一起再去鸟群那里看看。有些事情，光靠说...

say:16:1622414015:1.text: But for now, I'm not letting this roast go cold—this is what holidays are for.
say:16:1622414015:1.source_cn: 现在嘛，先让我好好享用这盘烤肉，这可是假期的宝藏！

narration:17:1622414016:1.text: You circle back to day-to-day life in the Serene Lyceum, with Hepler sharing a few more Mauler stories.
narration:17:1622414016:1.male: You circle back to day-to-day life in the Serene Lyceum, with Hepler sharing a few more Mauler stories.
narration:17:1622414016:1.female: You circle back to day-to-day life in the Serene Lyceum, with Hepler sharing a few more Mauler stories.

narration:18:1622414017:1.text: Dinner ends on an easy, relaxed note.

say:20:1622414005:1.text: You're incredibly direct about it. I like it, though. Better than those high-ranking mages who talk in riddles and call it wisdom.
say:20:1622414005:1.source_cn: 提醒是好的，但你的方式可真直接。不过我倒不讨厌，总比那...
say:20:1622414005:1.male: You're incredibly direct about it. I like it, though. Better than those high-ranking mages who talk in riddles and call it wisdom.
say:20:1622414005:1.female: You're incredibly direct about it. I like it, though. Better than those high-ranking mages who talk in riddles and call it wisdom.

choice:5:1:2.text: (Tell him his leave is almost over)
choice:5:1:2.male: (Tell him his leave is almost over)
choice:5:1:2.female: (Tell him his leave is almost over)
